messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — quarterly all-hands this Thu 11am PT. Please drop any agenda items or Qs here. Agenda draft below and link to collaborative notes: https://docs.google.com/meeting-notes/quarterly-hubbrief

Maya (People Ops): Agenda (30m):
- 11:00 — Exec update (Jordan)
- 11:10 — Product & roadmap highlights (Anika)
- 11:18 — Runtime/infrastructure snapshot (Oliver)
- 11:24 — Reliability & recent incident learnings (Sam)
- 11:28 — Q&A + closing

Maya (People Ops): Recording will be posted to the shared drive after. If you want to present, reply with what you need (slides, demo, 5/10 min).

Oliver (Eng): Can we add a 2-min note on the new autoscaling policy? small slide + link to perf numbers.

Anika (Product): I can demo the dedicated capacity rollout (5 min). Will need screen sharing and one slide.

Sam (SRE): I'll do a concise incident recap — 3 min. TL;DR, root cause and mitigation + where we're changing runbooks.

Sophia (Design): Propose a 60s demo of the new onboarding flow at the end? low risk, short.

Jordan (CEO): Please add a 3-min timeboxed Q&A towards the final 5 minutes. Folks — bring questions. Also will call out hiring priorities and partner integrations.

Maya (People Ops): Cool — updated agenda on the doc. If you want to be on the hero slide, upload by Wed EOD. Link: https://docs.google.com/meeting-notes/quarterly-hubbrief

CalendarBot: Event created: Quarterly Hubbrief — Thu 11:00-11:30 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode: redwood).

Maya (People Ops): Accessibility note — captions enabled on Zoom, recording will include captions + transcript. If you need offline viewing, ping me.

Anika (Product): Heads-up — I'll run a 2-step demo: local prod traffic -> Dedicated rollout. No dataset sharing. Need remote screen control enabled.

Oliver (Eng): Uploading perf chart now to the notes.

Sam (SRE): Quick ask — can someone capture a 1-line action for followups after the call? I'll add runbook PR link.

Sophia (Design): +1 on timebox, won't overrun. :raised_hands:

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have specific Qs for execs, drop them here or add to the doc under 'Questions for leadership'.

-- (post-meeting) --

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — recording and notes are live: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/quarterly-hubbrief/recording.mp4 and https://docs.google.com/meeting-notes/quarterly-hubbrief?action=post

Maya (People Ops): Key takeaways:
- Jordan: hiring focus on infra and customer reliability (recruiting pushes next quarter).
- Anika: Dedicated rollout -> gradual customers first week of May; integration checklist posted.
- Oliver: Autoscaling policy reduced 95th-pct latency spikes by ~12% in test; perf deck in notes.
- Sam: Incident recap — misrouted traffic due to config drift; mitigation = stricter deploy gate + runbook update (PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/327).

Maya (People Ops): Actions (owners & due dates):
- Oliver: finalize autoscale policy docs + share with sales (due 2026-05-07)
- Anika: post Dedicated rollout schedule + customer comms draft (due 2026-05-03)
- Sam: merge runbook change + schedule runbook drills (due 2026-04-30)
- Sophia: upload 60s onboarding demo clip to the asset library (due 2026-05-05)

Jordan (CEO): Thanks team — appreciate short, focused updates. I'll follow up on cross-team hiring ask next week.

Anika (Product): Added links to the rollout checklist in the notes.

Oliver (Eng): Done — PR for autoscale policy has been opened.

Sam (SRE): Runbook PR merged. Scheduling drill for next Tuesday.

Maya (People Ops): Closing — if any follow-up items not captured, reply here and I'll append. Thanks! :sparkles:
